programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Brott Efter Brott
programme.desc: Hank bildar en brottsbekämpningsförening i grannskapet när det börjar begås brott. Max tar på sig skulden för brotten för att dölja sin egen hemlighet, men Phoebe vet att han är oskyldig och det är upp till familjen att fånga den verkliga brottslingen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: South Park: Hur man äter med häcken
programme.desc: Cartman har slutligen gått för långt när ett spratt som inbegriper Kennys kinder leder till att han får en 'märklig propp' att gå.

programme.title: South Park: #Omtugg
programme.desc: Kyle vill spela tv-spel med sin lilllebror, men Ike vill inte längre spela med honom, så Kyle blir rädd för att nästa generation håller på att köra om honom.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: När killarna åker till Aspens skidbackar för första gången stöter Stan ihop med en av byborna och blir utmanad på en skidtävling.

programme.title: South Park: Visa snoppen
programme.desc: Killarna slår sig ihop för att kämpa för sina rättigheter.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog bängskog
programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas till Costa Ricas regnskog som en del av kören Getting Gay With Kids turné.

programme.title: South Park: Kattorgie (Del 1)
programme.desc: Shelley sitter barnvakt för Cartman och bjuder in sin olämplige pojkvän att hålla henne sällskap. Samtidigt löper Cartmans katt.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Den röde mannens girighet
programme.desc: De infödda amerikanarna vill jämna South Park med marken och bygga en motorväg för att få folk att komma till deras kasino.

programme.title: South Park: Frige Hatt
programme.desc: Killarna startar en proteströrelse när de inser att deras favoritfilmer blir 'förbättrade' för att släppas på nytt - och därigenom förstörda i processen.

programme.title: South Park: När det träffar fläkten
programme.desc: Det blir uppror i South Park när invånarna hör ordet '****' i det populära programmet 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1101
programme.desc: Dags att röra om i grytan! Fem maximalt taggade singeltjejer kliver in på lyxhotellet i Mexiko. Lyckan är total när programledaren Rebecca Stella berättar att killarna redan väntar på dem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1102
programme.desc: Första frukosten inleds med tårar och nervositeten ökar lavinartat när revanschparet Jesper och Jennifer dundrar in i huset.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1103
programme.desc: Dags för första parceremonin och det har redan uppstått spänningar mellan Camilla och Jesper. Vissa är övertygade om att de sitter säkra, men när är någonting någonsin som det verkar i Paradise Hotel?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1104
programme.desc: En het sjöjungfru har spolats upp på land och checkar in på hotellet för att förtrolla killarna med sin charm. Men inte alla uppskattar en charmig sjöungfru och svartsjukan är snart ett faktum.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1105
programme.desc: Akvariet ska fyllas upp med ytterligare en av hotellets gäster och deltagarna är oroliga. En gråtfri dag utlovas, men kommer det kunna hållas när ohyggliga sanningar dyker upp i pandoras ask?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1106
programme.desc: Hela havet stormar på hotellet och nya tvister sätter fart på paktandet. En oväntad vänskap sprider oro i vargflocken. Vem går det egentligen att lita på när det har blivit dags för parceremoni?

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jasper Danger
programme.desc: Jasper klär ut sig till hjälte på Halloween och misstas för att vara Kid Danger. Nu måste Kapten Man och och den riktiga Kid Danger rädda honom ur knipan.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rymdstenen
programme.desc: Henry får problem när han råkar bära med sig en rymdsten hem i ryggsäcken. När den mystiska stenen visar sig vara något helt annat måste han be Kapten Man om hjälp för att bli av med den.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Oskyldigt Misstänkt
programme.desc: Henry blir anklagad för att ha knuffat ner Debbie från taket. Kapten Man lovar att försöka rentvå Henry så att han får komma på hennes födelsedagsfest.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kamp på alla Håll
programme.desc: En ny elev tar Henrys plats i basketlaget, men Henry misstänker att nykomlingen Shawn ljuger om sin ålder. Kapten Man behöver hjälp av en gammal vän och måste komma över gammalt groll.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vilddjuret Henry
programme.desc: Henry ska gå på en viktig dejt, men allt går inte som planerat eftersom han råkar springa på en konstig apparat i Man-grottan.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Osynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kapten Mans vän Brad, som av en olyckshändelse blev osynlig för några år sedan, kommer på besök. Men det dröjer inte länge innan våra hjältar börjar tröttna på honom.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Varning för Spoiler
programme.desc: Henry och Ray tampas med stadens nya skurk, den irriterande Spoilern. Piper gör allt hon kan, och lite till, för att få gå med i en populär Kapten Man-fanclub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vinnaren tar allt
programme.desc: Kapten Man ser till att Henry får vara med i sitt favoritprogram Lyckohjulet för att kunna undersöka en serie inbrott som verkar vara ihopkopplade med TV-programmet. Men det dröjer inte länge förrän Henry själv råkar ut för ett inbrott.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jordens Undergång
programme.desc: När en supervulkan djupt under Swellview börjar visa tecken på att få ett utbrott blir Henry och Ray övertygade om att världen kommer gå under. Piper är övertygad om att hon är glutenintolerant.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hjärtligt Galet
programme.desc: När tjejen som Henry gillar går på en träff med en annan kille på alla hjärtans dag, bygger Schwoz en android för att Henry ska kunna göra henne svartsjuk. Ray går på en otrevlig träff med en av Henrys lärare.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Haunted House / The Hunk

programme.desc: Nathan testar en privatdetektiv som får spionera på honom under en dag. Ett taxibolag får en lösning för blyga kunder, och Nathan visar hur man avskedar nån.

programme.desc: Nathan hjälper en dejtinghemsida att dra till sig kvinnliga kunder, en partyplanerare får ett nytt sätt att skicka ut inbjudningar och Nathan delar med sig av sin egen självmotiveringsstrategi.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Dumb Starbucks

programme.title: Nathan For You: Electronics Store

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Tjejerna checkar in men lyckan byts snart i allvar. Det är dags för killarna att göra entré och genast måste alla bedöma varandra. Vem vill ha vem, och vem går att lita på?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Mörkret kryper in i Paradise Hotel när det blivit dags för skräckveckan. En mystisk mördare smyger omkring bland deltagarna och alla är plötsligt i fara.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Ett välkänt ansikte gör comeback i paradiset till tjejernas förtjusning. Killarna är inte alls lika roade och ser bara ett stort hot.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Festen tar en obehaglig vändning som slutar med att en deltagare lämnar paradiset. Deltagarna vaknar upp till en dyster morgon med många obesvarade frågor.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Den nya gästen på hotellet får i uppdrag att välja en partner. Men lyckan blir kortvarig för under kvällens fest blir det storbråk under Snurra flaskan-leken.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6

programme.title: South Park: Galen i apfonetik

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av Cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle behöver en njurtransplantation och Cartman är en perfekt donator, men Cartman sätter ett högt pris på sin njure: 10 miljoner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dör
programme.desc: Kenny utvecklar en obotlig sjukdom och stackars Stan vet inte hur han ska hantera det.

programme.title: South Park: Ögoninflammation
programme.desc: Det är Halloween i South Park och Kenny dödas av en fallande rymdstation och omvandlas till en zombie av en balsamerande vätska som är förgiftad med Worcester-sås.

programme.title: South Park: En stege till himlen

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman och Kyle blir osams om en magisk triangel de hittar under en arkeologisk utgrävning. Triangeln har kraften att omvandla Barbra Streisand till ett otäckt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Chefhjälpen

programme.title: South Park: Fåraktigt
programme.desc: När Stan tvingas gå till skolrådgivaren för att han samlar på sig så mycket onödigt, upptäcker han att mr Mackey också har problem med det.

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken

programme.title: South Park: Självantändning

programme.title: South Park: Utloggad

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporr
programme.desc: Killarna använder spelet Minecraft för att försöka att förhindra att deras föräldrar gör varandra illa.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O

programme.title: South Park: Stålar och guld
programme.desc: Stans farfar köper honom ett smycke till överpris från J&G Shopping Network och Stan försöker att rädda de äldre från att tv-shoppa - medan Cartman startar en egen tv-shop när han ser hur mycket man kan tjäna.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdjurens jul

programme.title: South Park: 1%

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Footage
programme.desc: An innocent mother of two is mysteriously shot in downtown Philadelphia. Surveillance cameras record every detail but can't unmask the killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
programme.desc: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom. A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope

programme.title: On the Case: Haunting Memories

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case

programme.desc: In defiance of their "father," Arik Soong's Augments devise a heinous plot against the Klingons which will surely lead to interstellar war.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Earth's embassy on Vulcan is bombed, and the ensuing investigation puts Archer and T'Pol on the trail of a Vulcan religious faction hiding in a treacherous desert.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: In Purgatory's Shadow
programme.desc: While Worf and Garak are imprisoned in the Gamma Quadrant, Sisko learns of a Dominion invasion.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: By Inferno's Light
programme.desc: Led by Gul Dukat, Cardassia joins the Dominion and prepares to take over the Alpha Quadrant.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Soldiers Of The Empire
programme.desc: On a mission for the Klingon Empire, Worf realizes that his friend General Martok is no longer fit to lead.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Children Of Time
programme.desc: 22. Children Of Time Sisko and the Defiant crew must choose between the lives they have always known and the lives of their own descendants.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blaze Of Glory
programme.desc: Sisko attempts to force his traitorous former officer to stop a final Maquis attack that could lead to the destruction of the Federation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: In The Cards
programme.desc: Jake and Nog risk an intergalactic incident in an innocent quest to lift Sisko's spirits.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ties Of Blood And Water
programme.desc: The imminent death of Kira's Cardassian "father" rekindles painful memories of losing her real father

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rocks And Shoals
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew are stranded on a remote planet with a dying Vorta and a small group of Jem'Hadar.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: His Way
programme.desc: Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadows And Symbols
programme.desc: Sisko's quest to find a mythical Bajoran orb leads him to unlock the truth about his own existence.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Caretaker, del 1
programme.desc: När de söker en saknad officer, sveps kommendör Kathryn Janeway och besättningen på rymdkryssaren Voyager 70 000 ljusår hemifrån.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Resistance
programme.desc: Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The inventor of the transporter, Emory Erickson, comes aboard Enterprise for a risky experiment.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Noncorporeal aliens study the Enterprise crew as they respond to a fatal viral infection brought on board from an away mission.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: In The Cards

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: A Time To Stand
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew embark on a secret mission in a captured Jem'Hadar warship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sons And Daughters
programme.desc: Worf must face his failuresm as a father when his estranged son volunteers for duty aboard a Klingon ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Favor The Bold
programme.desc: While Kira prepares for the destruction of the Federation minefield, Sisko plans to retake Deep Space Nine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sacrifice Of Angels

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Resistance
programme.desc: Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Resolutions
programme.desc: After contracting a deadly virus, Janeway and Chakotay are forced into exile on a planet that shields them from the effects of the fatal disease.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Macrocosm
programme.desc: Janeway, Neelix and the Doctor must retake Voyager from an infestation of microorganisms.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Scientific Method
programme.desc: The Voyager crew is invaded by an alien race conducting dangerous experiments.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Year Of Hell, Part 1
programme.desc: A disruption in the space-time continuum forces the crew to evacuate Voyager.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Year Of Hell, Part 2
programme.desc: A badly damaged Voyager with a skeleton crew leads an armada of interplanetary ships against them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.
